evals.prompt:
I have a Dutch-language Florida-style road trip itinerary (5 days, Orlando + Nature). Please process it with the travelguide-composer skill:
- Style: Navigational Roadbook & Connoisseur (Michelin Green)
- Format: Word DOCX
- Ages: 2 adults (35-40), 1 teenager (15)
- Dietary needs: none
- Interests: theme parks, nature, wildlife

The itinerary file is at: c:\\projects\\skills\\travelguide-composer\\travelguide-composer-workspace\\inputs\\florida_style_mock.md

Save the output DOCX to: c:\\projects\\skills\\travelguide-composer\\travelguide-composer-workspace\\iteration-1\\roadbook-docx-dutch\\{config}\\outputs\\florida_roadbook.docx

Also save the enriched markdown to: c:\\projects\\skills\\travelguide-composer\\travelguide-composer-workspace\\iteration-1\\roadbook-docx-dutch\\{config}\\outputs\\florida_enriched.md
evals.expected_output: A DOCX roadbook file with: (1) table of contents, (2) per-day structure with Algemeen/Hotel/Maaltijden/Gereserveerde activiteiten/Dagindeling sections, (3) bare URLs replaced with rich descriptive text, (4) empty meal slots filled with restaurant recommendations, (5) embedded photos from real sources, (6) climate/timezone table, (7) consistent Michelin Green roadbook styling

evals.prompt:

- Style: Boutique, Design & Minimalist (Cereal/Wallpaper* style)
- Format: Dynamic HTML
- Ages: 2 adults (38, 40), 2 children (8, 12)
- Dietary needs: Vegan + gluten-free
- Interests: art, history, hiking, family activities

The itinerary file is at: c:\\projects\\skills\\travelguide-composer\\travelguide-composer-workspace\\inputs\\tuscany_gaps_mock.md

Save the output HTML to: c:\\projects\\skills\\travelguide-composer\\travelguide-composer-workspace\\iteration-1\\gap-filling-boutique-html\\{config}\\outputs\\tuscany_guide.html

Also save the enriched markdown to: c:\\projects\\skills\\travelguide-composer\\travelguide-composer-workspace\\iteration-1\\gap-filling-boutique-html\\{config}\\outputs\\tuscany_enriched.md
evals.expected_output: An HTML travel guide with: (1) all 5 dining gaps filled with real vegan/gluten-free restaurants with addresses and hours, (2) afternoon activity suggestion filled with family-friendly options, (3) bare URLs turned into rich descriptive travel essays (2-3 paragraphs each), (4) real photos embedded with source credits, (5) Boutique CSS theme applied with minimalist styling, (6) interactive Leaflet maps for key locations, (7) pacing/energy tier labels per day
